## Active-Tick Depth Results (Check 2)

| Pool | min | median | max | variation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **uniswap_v3 5bp** | $18,360 | $18,824 | $18,826 | ±2% (LP adjustments) |
| **sushiswap_v3 5bp** | $12.73 | $12.73 | $12.73 | **0% — constant across 60 obs** |

```
uni : sushi median depth ratio ≈ 1,479×

The constant $12.73 across all 60 observations indicates that the sushi
LP position spans a wide-enough tick range that the active 10bp slice
never crossed an LP boundary during the entire 29.5-minute window.
Within that wide-spanning position, the LP concentration is so thin
that each 10bp slice contains ~$13 of value.

This is "dust at the live tick despite TVL on the books" — the same
mechanism observed for Sushi ETH/USDT ($21 ATD vs $84.5k TVL) but more
extreme.
```

## Notes

- READ-ONLY: direct ethers.js RPC, same-block via `blockTag`, no Redis writes, no config mutation.
- Active-tick depth follows Uniswap V3 §6.2.2 formula (token1 = USDC ≈ $1; token0 = WBTC at current price ≈ $73,600).
- This is the **third operational use** of the generalized `surface_depth_probe.js` constitutional gate, and the **first non-ETH-pair use** — validates the probe's decimal-handling and tickSpacing inference work correctly for novel pair types.
- This report describes a **pre-integration** measurement: pools never appeared in `surfaces/registry.json`.
